name: swarlipi
description: Fontless Bhatkhande notation renderer — real Unicode letters plus CSS/SVG marks, in four scripts.
author: BeeJaySoft

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'';if(!ua.includes('pnpm')){console.error('\\n  Publish with pnpm, not npm.\\n  npm ignores publishConfig field overrides, so it would ship a manifest whose main/types/exports point at src/*.ts.\\n  Run: pnpm publish --access public\\n');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.prepack: pnpm run build:dist && pnpm run build:fonts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const need=['dist/index.js','dist/index.d.ts','dist/bridge.js','src/index.css','fonts/swarlipi-fonts.css','fonts/SwarlipiGurmukhi-Variable.ttf','fonts/SwarlipiGurmukhi-Variable.woff2'];const missing=need.filter(f=>!fs.existsSync(f));if(missing.length){console.error('\\n  Refusing to pack: built output missing\\n   '+missing.join('\\n   ')+'\\n');process.exit(1)}" && node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m=>{if(typeof m.renderSwarlipi!=='function')throw new Error('dist/index.js exports no renderSwarlipi');return import('./dist/bridge.js')}).then(m=>{if(typeof m.planBridges!=='function')throw new Error('dist/bridge.js exports no planBridges')}).catch(e=>{console.error('\\n  Refusing to pack: dist does not load under Node ESM\\n   '+e.message+'\\n');process.exit(1)})"
